_comment: Wan2.1 diffusion benchmark set: 4 physics-flavoured prompts x 1 seed at a 2 s horizon (33 frames, 192x320). `prompt` must be one of the embeddings made by scripts/encode_prompts.py (the defaults match these). Quality is agreement with the unoptimized model's video for the same seed (WanReferenceScenarios), NOT physics: no physics scorer exists for Wan here. Small on purpose: each rollout is ~12 s on a laptop GPU, and full 480p x 81 frames takes minutes. Add seeds for statistical power: for optimizations that change the noise, the effective sample size is the number of distinct (prompt, seed) pairs.

prompts.prompt: A red ball rolls down a wooden ramp and bounces on the floor.
Water is poured from a pitcher into a glass on a kitchen counter.
A robot arm picks up a red cube from a table and places it into a bin.
A car drives through a busy four-way intersection while pedestrians cross the street.
